name: claude-web
description: Community-observed claude.ai web knobs, not vendor documentation. Mirrors spec except that _meta.ui.domain is enforced — measured in a 36-render controlled A/B posted to ext-apps#671 (absent: mounts with a rotating origin; correct: mounts with a stable origin; wrong: 0/8 mounts) — and that the sandbox proxy never applies the resource's _meta.ui.csp (ext-apps#761), so declared resourceDomains/connectDomains do not reach the policy the sandbox is served.
